# WITSML Integration Guide

Standard: WITSML 2.1.1

Document API RP 13D provides mud system terminology.

## 7.4 Data Exchange Process

The Data Exchange Process sends FLOWIN, FLOWOUT and RPM values.

Hookload is also called Hook Load in some vendor exports.

Standpipe Pressure (SPP) is reported in psi.

Refer to Section 7.4 and Table 2.

| Mnemonic | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FLOWIN | Flow Rate | gpm |
| RPM | Rotary Speed | rpm |
